headline: Study finds chat and reasoning LLMs unreliable as standalone protocol verifiers
summary: A September 12 journal paper evaluates GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek v4 Flash on 130 obfuscated AnB/AnBx protocols covering 388 security goals, with three runs per configuration and formal-verifier references. The authors report a chat-versus-reasoning trade-off: chat modes recall more attacks but generate many false alarms, while reasoning raises precision and misses more attacks. On their imbalanced goal set, both chat configurations score below a 77.1% always-secure accuracy baseline; agreement authentication goals remain difficult, and self-reported confidence is poorly calibrated. The paper recommends pre-screening only, with formal confirmation. These are author-reported results; the journal article and public artifact were not independently reproduced in this review.
